attributes.name: social icon shape
attributes.definition: The shape of the container or badge holding each social media icon.

values.definition: Icons are in round or circular containers/badges.
Icons are in square or rounded-rectangle containers.

attributes.name: social icon container style
attributes.definition: How the social icon container is rendered visually (outline, filled, or other).

values.definition: Container has a border/outline without fill.
Style of container fill/outline not stated.

attributes.name: social icon content type
attributes.definition: What is rendered inside the social icon: icon-font glyph, letter, or image.

values.definition: An icon-font or SVG glyph of the platform logo.
A text letter or initials stand in for the logo.

attributes.name: social icon label placement
attributes.definition: Position of the icon relative to its text label.

values.definition: Icon sits to the left of a text label.
No text label alongside the icon.
